svg.aria-label: Constructed data, seed 660. Five concentrations share intrinsic rates and a capacity of 120 RU. A retains solvent steps; B compares deviations before and after double referencing; C shows corrected records and global fits; D is data minus model. Each original channel has noise SD 0.2 RU.
